note:
Segoe UI Symbol, Word's fallback for a bullet glyph the paragraph face lacks
(U+25B8 and friends): ships only inside Office, so the ink comes from the real
face where installed, else Apple Symbols. The overrides carry its 1.3301em
line (hhea 1.0791 / 0.2510) split at the same 0.36em baseline as above.

faces.src: local('Segoe UI Symbol'), local('SegoeUISymbol'), local('Apple Symbols'), local('AppleSymbols')
